name: Inspection line
note: Stage 1: a recorded run of the Task agent where one had every field right, else a written reference dialogue (task_mode). Stage 2: a recorded run of the Layout agent (layout.run). Stage 3: coordination numbers from studio/data (final RobotATC campaign).

chat.text: An inspection line for a 1.5 kg part. The part comes in on a feeder, is measured at one station and marked at the next, and leaves on a tray. Measuring takes 1.5 s and marking takes 1.5 s, and the robot waits meanwhile. We need 400 parts an hour.
chat.text_ko: 1.5 kg 부품의 검사 라인입니다. 부품이 공급기로 들어와 한 스테이션에서 측정되고 다음 스테이션에서 각인된 뒤 트레이로 나갑니다. 측정 1.5초, 각인 1.5초이고 그동안 로봇은 기다립니다. 시간당 400개가 필요합니다.

chat.text: I propose the robot program visits four points in this order: P1 is the feeder where the part arrives, P2 is the measurement station, P3 is the marking station, and P4 is the tray where the finished part leaves. chat.text: The payload is the mass of the heaviest part plus the gripper: 1.5 kg part + 0.5 kg gripper = 2.0 kg. (p. 216)

chat.text:
I calculated the robot cycle time as follows:
1. Cycle time: 3600 s / 400 parts = 9.0 s per part.
2. Machine or station time: measurement 1.5 s + marking 1.5 s = 3.0 s.
3. Moves in one cycle: pick P1→P2, pick P2→P3, pick P3→P4 (3 carrying moves) plus one empty move from P4 back to P1 = 4 moves.
4. Time per move: (9.0 – 3.0) / 4 = 1.5 s per move.
(See textbook, p. 225 for cycle time calculation.)
